title: Lead AI or ML Engineer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead product ionization of AI/ML systems on Azure and other cloud platforms, supporting the full journey from experimentation to deployment
* Define architecture and standards for data pipelines, learning workflows, and model\-serving APIs across AI/ML systems
* Design, deploy, and operate production model\-serving APIs across batch and real\-time serving patterns, with clear SLAs for latency, throughput, and availability
* Build and maintain Python\-based automation, tooling, and services supporting AI/ML workflows and deployments
* Define and maintain CI/CD pipelines and engineering standards for AI/ML workflows (code, data, and models)
* Containerize and orchestrate AI/ML workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, with infrastructure managed as code
* Own the design and maintenance of Dev / Stage / Prod environments on Azure
* Govern management of model artifacts, registries, and feature/representation stores
* Lead monitoring of system health, data drift, and model drift with alerting and remediation strategies
* Own post\-deployment support, incident response, and continuous improvement
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* 8\+ years of experience building and operating production systems with real\-world constraints
* Hands\-on experience with Azure cloud services, infrastructure management, and cloud\-native deployment
* Experience designing and operating production APIs and model\-serving endpoints under defined SLAs and failure modes
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and managing model versioning and registries
* Experience implementing observability for production systems: logging, metrics, alerting, and drift detection
* Solid software engineering fundamentals in Python, with solid software design, automation, and debugging skills
* Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and workflow orchestration for containerized workloads

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent)
* Experience with vector and NoSQL databases, RAG pipelines, and GenAI platform engineering
* Experience with distributed systems and streaming/event platforms (e.g., Kafka)
* Experience operating AI/ML systems in a regulated or healthcare environment
* Working knowledge of AI/ML lifecycles, model deployment patterns, and MLflow or equivalent tooling

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Team Leader - Operations
description:
The **Role**

This is not a routine policy\-processing or supervisory role.

The Operations Lead will own the complete operational lifecycle across policy issuance,

endorsements, cancellations, SLA/TAT, dealer support, insurer coordination, operational

escalations, team productivity and technology\-enabled process automation.

The person will lead the L2 Operations function and work closely with Sales, Finance, Product

and Technology teams to ensure that operational issues do not become business bottlenecks.

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on operator, problem solver and process owner who can

manage people, processes, partners and technology together.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Motor Insurance Operations

Own day\-to\-day execution and quality of:

**New Motor Policy Issuance**

**Renewals**

**Endorsements**

**Cancellations**

**Policy corrections**

**Break\-in cases**

**Inspection coordination**

**Documentation and verification**

**Premium / coverage / add\-on validation**

**Policy servicing and related operational requests**

Ensure accuracy, compliance, productivity and SLA adherence across the complete process.

2\. SLA \& Operations Management

Own operational SLA/TAT from case initiation to closure.

Monitor real\-time operational performance and pending cases.

Identify SLA risks and intervene before they become escalations.

Track SLA performance across insurers, portals, dealers, regions and business channels.

Establish structured reason, category and sub\-category classification for operational

exceptions.

Conduct RCA for SLA breaches and recurring operational issues.

Drive corrective and preventive actions.

Maintain operational dashboards and performance reviews.

Ensure consistent SLA adherence across the L2 function.

The expectation is to prevent SLA breaches—not simply report them.

3\. Technology\-Enabled Operations \& Automation

Lead the evolution of a technology\-enabled insurance operations model.

Drive adoption and optimization of AI/ML\-enabled and intelligent workflow solutions

across policy issuance and servicing.

Identify repetitive, high\-volume and error\-prone processes for automation.

Work with Product \& Technology teams to convert operational requirements into

scalable solutions.

Monitor automation effectiveness, processing accuracy and operational throughput.

Analyse exceptions and recurring failure patterns and drive resolution.

Continuously reduce manual dependency and operational turnaround time.

Ensure appropriate operational fallback processes for technology or system exceptions.

The goal: faster processing, higher accuracy, lower operational dependency and scalable

growth.

4\. Insurer, Aggregator \& Portal Management

Act as the operational SPOC for insurers, aggregators and external operational partners.

Coordinate with insurers and aggregators for issuance, servicing and escalation matters.

Manage insurer/portal\-related operational issues.

Maintain appropriate redundancy and fallback processes for critical operational

dependencies.

Track insurer\-wise operational performance and SLA.

Ensure timely escalation and closure of unresolved issues.

Work with Technology/Product teams to address recurring portal/process issues.

5\. Dealer \& Sales Operations Support

Own Operations as a focal point for Sales and Dealer support.

Resolve dealer operational queries and escalations.

Support Sales on issuance, endorsement, cancellation and servicing requirements.

Define and maintain Sales–Operations escalation processes and response SLAs.

Ensure dealer issues are tracked through closure.

Identify recurring dealer issues and eliminate root causes.

Work closely with Sales to ensure operational readiness for business growth.

6\. L2 Team Leadership \& Productivity

Lead the L2 Operations team and own its performance.

Allocate workload based on volume and priority.

Set individual and team productivity expectations.

Monitor workload, capacity, productivity and quality.

Conduct daily/weekly operational reviews.

Coach and develop team members.

Identify performance gaps and initiate corrective actions/PIPs where required.

Manage shift planning, leave and operational coverage.

Build a high\-accountability and high\-productivity culture.

7\. Wallet, Recharge \& Operational Reconciliation

Coordinate and own operational resolution for:

Dealer wallet/recharge issues

Recharge failures

Balance discrepancies

Policy\-to\-wallet reconciliation

Dealer payment\-related operational queries

Coordination with Finance on operational reconciliation and settlement issues

8\. MIS, Analytics \& Operational Governance

Establish a reliable Operations Control \& Reporting framework covering:

Policy volumes

SLA/TAT

Pending cases and ageing

Error/quality rates

Productivity

Insurer/portal performance

Dealer/region performance

Escalations

Root\-cause trends

Automation effectiveness

Operational exceptions  
Strong Excel / Power BI / SQL / analytical capability will be an advantage.

**Key Success Metrics**  
The candidate will be measured on measurable business outcomes, including:

* SLA/TAT adherence
* Policy issuance accuracy
* Endorsement \& cancellation TAT
* Pending\-case ageing
* Escalation resolution time
* Team productivity
* Dealer support SLA
* Insurer/partner issue resolution
* Operational error rate
* Automation\-enabled processing efficiency
* Reduction in manual intervention
* Process improvement and cost efficiency

What We're Looking For

**Must Have**

**5–8 years of experience in Motor/General Insurance Operations.**

* **Strong hands\-on experience in policy issuance and servicing**
* **Good understanding of endorsements, cancellations, renewals, corrections and break\-in cases**
* **Proven experience managing SLA/TAT and high\-volume operations**
* **2–3\+ years of team\-handling/L2 management experience**
* **Experience coordinating with multiple insurers/insurance partners**
* **Strong escalation and stakeholder\-management skills**
* **Strong Excel/MIS and analytical capability**
* **Ability to identify operational bottlenecks and drive RCA/corrective action**
* **Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment**

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Test Engineer - Automation (Selenium + Java + Playwright +AI Testing)
description:
**About Gartner IT:**  

Join a world\-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  

  

**About the role:**  

Gartner is looking for a well\-rounded and motivated test engineer to join its agile, scrum\-based Sales and Services technology team which is responsible for testing web, agentic and API applications and integrations to support its continuous delivery. You will contribute to maintenance and development of test automation frameworks and leverage AI tools for testing deliverables. This role requires technical skills and a collaborative approach in a fast\-paced Agile environment
  

  

**What you will do:**

* Develop and maintain quality assurance plans, test data, procedures, and scripts.
* Ability to execute functional testing along with an ability to identify opportunities for automation and create scripts. Design, build, and maintain effective test automation solutions which meet requirements and specifications. (Smoke, Functional, Regression, etc.)
* Leverage AI\-driven tools and techniques to strengthen both manual and automated testing workflows — including AI\-assisted test case generation, intelligent test execution, and automated result and support the validation of internally built AI agents
* Exposure to web technologies
* Ensure accurate and complete converges of designated test areas.
* Write effective manual/automated test scripts within the framework of approved testing tools using documented requirements and technical specifications provided by project team
* Provide test status, document defects and potential risks
* Effectively document defects using automated defect tracking software.
* Understand new product requirements and coordinate work across multiple project phases or complex assignments.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and the ability to balance quality, timelines, and resource constraints to deliver high\-quality products.

**What you will need :**  

Strong IT professional with 4\-6 yrs of experience in testing applications via both manual and automated tests. The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative problem\-solving skills along with high level of ownership and accountability. Ability to work in a collaborative team environment with good interpersonal skills.
  

  

**Must have:**

* 4\-6 years’ experience in an IT or Business environment testing highly scalable applications with significant experience designing automation platforms and writing automated tests
* **Proficiency in automating web applications across platforms using test automation tools and frameworks, including Selenium, TestNG, Playwright and/or Pytest test framework.**
* **Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Jmeter), including an ability to customize the code for load test creation.**
* **Well\-versed in Java/Git Source control.**
* **Experience in writing SQL queries, procedures, and function.**
* **Knowledge of Salesforce platform and database validation using SOQL**
* Hands on experience testing web services
* **Strong exposure to AI\-driven or agentic testing approaches leveraging multiple AI models**
* Expertise in QA prompt engineering, including designing and optimizing prompts to effectively drive AI agents for test generation, execution, and validation
* Able to independently support projects and work with various stakeholders

**What you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field required
* Excellent communication and prioritization skills.
* Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast\-paced AGILE\-SCRUM environment.
* Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.
* Strong desire to improve upon their skills in software testing and technologies

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Networking and Compute Infrastructure
description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Solution Architect, Networking and compute Infrastructure to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centres. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyse, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!  

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Develop tooling to automate and manage of large\-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self\-service consumption of resources.
* Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage.
* Perform troubleshooting bottom up from bare metal, operating system, software stack and application level.
* Being a technical resource, develop, re\-define and document standard methodologies to share with customer and internal teams Support activities and engage in POCs/POVs for future improvements.
* Experience with system administration on Linux systems required (CentOS, RHEL, and Ubuntu preferred)

**What We Need to See:**

* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering fields with at least 5\+ years’ work or research experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data centre compute architecture.
* Advance knowledge of HPC, AI \& EVPN, BGP, OSPF, VXLAN protocols.
* Deep understanding of DC architecture fundamentals such as compute, storage (PFS) \& InfiniBand, Ethernet, NVLink.
* Experience running HPC performance benchmarks, cluster health checks, and profiling tools to identify infrastructure bottlenecks.
* Python programming, bash scripting experience and Advance Linux knowledge.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning and comfortable with automation and configuration management tools including Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet. Chef, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.
* Excellent customer\-facing and communication skills (verbal and written in both languages), enabling effective engagement with customers, partners, and cross\-functional teams across the India region. Listening skills in English are critical.
* Willingness to travel

**Ways To Stand Out from The Crowd:**

* Knowledge of CPU and/or GPU architecture including of Kubernetes, container related microservice technologies.
* Background with RDMA (InfiniBand or RoCE) fabrics.
* Linux or Networking Certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE) or NVIDIA\-related certifications.
* Deep Knowledge on observability stack and build experience.

title: QE Manager
description:
About This Role
**6 years of experience**  

**Skills: Selenium, Playwright, Java / Python, REST API Testing, BDD / Cucumber, JUnit / Mockito, CI/CD, Postman / RestAssured, Performance Testing, Git, SQL, Agile, Shift\-Left Testing, Defect Management, JIRA**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineer with 6\+ years of experience to design, build, and execute automated test solutions across enterprise applications. You will bring strong test automation skills combined with solid domain knowledge — embedding quality as a first\-class concern across Agile delivery teams. This is a hands\-on technical QE role requiring strong coding ability, deep automation framework expertise, and a shift\-left quality mindset.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering UI, API, integration, and E2E testing layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright supporting functional, regression, and cross\-browser testing.
* Build and maintain REST API test automation suites using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman covering API contracts and business logic validation.
* Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito collaborating with developers to improve code testability and test coverage.
* Build and maintain BDD test frameworks using Cucumber and Gherkin working with product owners and BAs to define business\-readable acceptance criteria.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines implementing quality gates that prevent defective code from reaching production.
* Champion shift\-left testing practices engaging with developers and architects early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute performance and load tests using JMeter or Gatling validating application scalability under realistic load conditions.
* Manage defect triage and reporting logging, prioritising, and tracking defects in Jira with clear business impact assessment.
* Mentor and coach junior QE team members sharing automation expertise across the team.

**What We're Looking For**


* 6\+ years of quality engineering experience with strong hands\-on technical automation expertise.
* Strong automation skills using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright building scalable, maintainable frameworks from scratch.
* Solid Java or Python skills writing production\-quality test automation code.
* Proven REST API testing expertise using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman.
* Experience with BDD frameworks including Cucumber and Gherkin for business\-readable test scenario automation.
* Strong CI/CD integration experience embedding quality gates into Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions pipelines.

title: Senior Manager SIOP Planning
description:
### **Role Responsibilities:**


* Own digital product strategy, roadmap, governance, adoption, and value realization for supply chain planning capabilities, including enterprise planning and supply chain technology platforms.
* Partner with SIOP, Manufacturing, Materials, Operations, and Digital stakeholders to align business priorities with technology investments and supply chain capability development.
* Lead end\-to\-end supply chain process transformation across Made\-to\-Stock (MTS), Made\-to\-Order (MTO), and Engineer\-to\-Order (ETO) business \& operating models, driving standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct business process and solution architecture assessments to identify opportunities that improve service, inventory performance, productivity, and operational effectiveness across the value chain.
* Develop inventory optimization strategies, including MEIO (Multi\-Echelon Inventory Optimization), inventory segmentation, safety stock policies, and replenishment methodologies.
* Translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions through collaboration with technology and development teams, leveraging automation, advanced analytics, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Lead cross\-functional transformation programs and strategic initiatives, ensuring stakeholder alignment, execution discipline, and achievement of business outcomes.
* Drive complexity reduction initiatives, including SKU rationalization, portfolio optimization, planning parameter governance, and supply chain simplification efforts.
* Develop KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, business cases, and benefit\-tracking methodologies that support executive decision\-making and value realization.
* Partner with Master Data Management teams to improve data quality, governance, and accessibility across planning and operational systems.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business and digital leadership by providing strategic recommendations, identifying transformation opportunities, and helping define long\-term business and technology priorities

### **Role Purpose**


* As the Senior Manager, SIOP Digital Partner — Enterprise Planning and Digital Transformation, you will shape and lead Carrier's supply chain planning capability strategy, driving digital transformation across planning, procurement, inventory, and fulfillment operations. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution — translating complex supply chain requirements into scalable digital solutions that improve service, reduce cost, and enable competitive advantage across Carrier's global factory network.

### **Minimum Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in supply chain planning, operations, digital transformation, program management, or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of SIOP/IBP, demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience leading cross\-functional business transformation and technology initiatives.
* Experience with enterprise planning and ERP platforms (e.g., Kinaxis, SAP, or similar solutions).
* Ability to translate business requirements into technology\-enabled solutions and drive adoption across stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and lead initiatives across business, operations, and technology organizations.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* MBA or advanced degree in a related field.
* Fluency in Mandarin will be preferred
* Experience with Kinaxis, KetteQ, LeanDNA, SAP ECC, and/or SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience with inventory optimization strategies, including MEIO, inventory segmentation, and safety stock methodologies.
* Knowledge of supply chain solution architecture, enterprise system integrations, APIs, master data governance, and data management principles.
* Experience leveraging advanced analytics, automation, AI/ML, or decision intelligence solutions.
* Experience supporting MTS, MTO, and ETO manufacturing environments.
* APICS/ASCM, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or similar professional certification.
